ranked.headline: Explicit structural priors are being built into omics models for incomplete data
ranked.summary: Single-cell and multi-omic tools increasingly encode alignment, spatial, and regulatory priors to handle weakly paired or missing measurements.

ranked.headline: External priors fused with learned representations for drug and perturbation prediction
ranked.summary: Early-February 2026 preprints and publications integrate network, structural, and knowledge priors into predictive models for drugs and cells.

ranked.headline: Integrating epigenomic, expression and contact data to annotate regulatory elements
ranked.summary: Regulatory annotation is increasingly coupled to expression, contact, and mutation data, with new single-cell epigenomic atlases and deep learning models.

ranked.headline: Spatial and regulatory structure is being encoded directly into single-cell and spatial…
ranked.summary: Spatial, regulatory, and morphological structure is now built into model architectures rather than applied as a downstream analysis step.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models map regulatory DNA sequence onto promoter and gene expression
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers benchmark sequence-to-function models on personal genomes, promoter activity, and TF binding site prediction.

ranked.headline: Regularized and graph-based models integrate high-dimensional genomic and multi-omics data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply penalized, network-regularized, and factorization methods to high-dimensional omics prediction and feature selection.

ranked.headline: Spatial and single-cell transcriptomics resolve tumor subclones and cellular lineage…
ranked.summary: Single-cell and spatial data now expose somatic mutations, subclonal divergence and metastasis-initiating cells within tumors.

ranked.headline: Biological constraints are being encoded into genome sequence models
ranked.summary: Sequence-based genome models are increasingly paired with evolutionary, metabolic, or benchmark-level constraints to improve prediction and design.

ranked.headline: Interactive resources couple curated genomic data with reproducible analysis logic
ranked.summary: Preprints and 2026 publications pair interactive execution with harmonized data and graph-based interpretation.

ranked.headline: Computational models predict how electric fields and stiffness steer cell migration
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published model pair biophysical prediction of competing cues with scalable tooling for multiscale tumor simulations.

ranked.headline: Conditioning generative molecular design on learned representations beyond structure
ranked.summary: Preprints from February 2026 apply flow matching, GFlowNets, and transformer embeddings to conditioned molecule generation with reported benchmarks.

ranked.headline: Genome-scale comparisons link sequence variation to habitat and regulatory divergence
ranked.summary: Expanded gene catalogues, structure predictions and multi-species alignments now enable genome-resolved comparison across taxa and environments.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic models link molecular kinetics to system-level dynamics across scales
ranked.summary: GEAGS couples gene expression to logistic growth to explain transient oscillations, while Notch studies test early-warning indicators of transitions.

ranked.headline: Learned models predict peptide, protein, and lipid engagement with membranes
ranked.summary: Learned predictors are now being coupled to membrane-interface observables derived from molecular dynamics simulations.

ranked.headline: Model structure shapes accuracy of time-dependent inference of sequence evolution
ranked.summary: Recent work tests structural assumptions in phylodynamic models against learned models, somatic division processes, and simulated within-host ground truth.

ranked.headline: Computational models guide design of RNA editing, sensing, and primer sequences
ranked.summary: Sequence-level design tools now pair machine learning and algorithmic guarantees with RNA editing, RNA sensor, and primer assay development.

ranked.headline: Heterogeneity as a model component steers epidemic and cooperative outcomes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints treat heterogeneity in networks, host state, environment and transmission noise as tractable model drivers of population outcomes.

ranked.headline: Scope of DIA quantification and LC-MS acquisition choice under short gradients
ranked.summary: Recent DIA and LFQ studies jointly address quantification scope, end-to-end workflows, and acquisition choice under high-throughput gradients.

ranked.headline: Inferring genomic history from sparse, noisy, or low-coverage sequencing data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers apply inference methods that tolerate error, sparsity, and low coverage across single-cell, population, and metagenomic data.

ranked.headline: Haplotype-resolved assemblies extended to autopolyploid and phased cultivar genomes
ranked.summary: Long-read and Hi-C haplotype assembly now yields near telomere-to-telomere autotetraploid genomes, paired with allele-aware analysis tools.

ranked.headline: Ligation bias, circRNA artifacts and mixed models shape quantitative RNA measurement
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications reassess whether small and circular RNA measurements reflect biology, from library chemistry to single-cell model choice.

ranked.headline: Multimodal and baseline-aware models are advancing genomic variant interpretation
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers pair multimodal evidence and state-based annotation with explicit baselines for variant interpretation.

ranked.headline: Automated pipelines turn microbial reads into genomes, strains, and plasmid profiles
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers pair end-to-end microbial genome pipelines with benchmarks run on simulated data.

ranked.headline: New tools compare genomes, map coevolution, and extract features from sequence data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications add tunable distance metrics, phylogeny-linked coevolution views, and unified viral RdRp profile databases.

ranked.headline: Deep learning segments tissue and anomalies in histopathology and live-cell imaging
ranked.summary: Learned models are scaling analysis of gigapixel tissue images from whole-slide pathology to tomographic and live-cell readouts.

ranked.headline: Restraint-guided and energetics-based ensembles resolve disordered protein conformations
ranked.summary: Experimental restraints and AlphaFold-based ensembles now yield atomic-resolution views of disordered protein states.

ranked.headline: Technical validation of single-cell RNA-seq data is preceding biological interpretation
ranked.summary: Coverage bias and integration parameter sensitivity are emerging as checkable error sources in single-cell and multi-omics analyses.

ranked.headline: Physical models link chromatin folding and DNA topology to gene regulation
ranked.summary: Physical models now reconstruct high-resolution chromatin organization and predict supercoiling-dependent expression from genome architecture.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks and splitting choices shape evaluation of predictive bioactivity models
ranked.summary: Recent studies pair standardized benchmarks with explicit control of splitting and seed variance in predictive bioactivity models.

ranked.headline: Protein language models for fitness, structure tokens, and TCR-pMHC binding
ranked.summary: Five new preprints test protein language models on fitness benchmarks, structure tokenization, and TCR-pMHC interaction prediction.

ranked.headline: Generative models now sample protein dynamics and design antibodies from structure
ranked.summary: Diffusion, flow, and autoregressive generators now target MD trajectories, backbones, and CDR regions rather than static structures alone.

ranked.headline: Residual recombination and chromosomal breakpoints shape genome structure and selection
ranked.summary: Recent 2026 studies connect residual recombination, breakpoint-proximal selection, and germline mutation rates across hybrid, mammalian, and amphioxus genomes.

ranked.headline: Computational models probe tumor-immune regulation and checkpoint-directed interventions
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple mechanistic, structural, and single-cell models to generate testable hypotheses for immune-directed therapy.

ranked.headline: Computational methods resolve mosaic, copy-number and oligogenic genomic variants
ranked.summary: Population-scale cohorts such as 470,727 UK Biobank genomes now allow explicit, dataset-specific evaluation of variant detection methods.

ranked.headline: Residue-level simulations probe interactions in condensates and membrane supercomplexes
ranked.summary: Coarse-grained and residue-level models now resolve the contacts and transport that govern condensate and membrane assembly behavior.

ranked.headline: Validating ancient DNA and ancient human inference tools against their known limits
ranked.summary: Simulation, metadata, and epigenetic-clock assessments now test how reliably current ancient DNA tools support inference.

ranked.headline: In silico prioritization of synonymous and missense variants with structural context
ranked.summary: Resources now integrate multilevel annotation, ML classifiers and structural modeling to prioritize variants beyond coding missense changes.

ranked.headline: Predicting centromeres and accessible chromatin from genome assemblies and motifs
ranked.summary: Long-read and pangenome assemblies now support de novo prediction of centromeres and accessible chromatin from sequence-derived features.

ranked.headline: Computational inference from tandem mass spectra for metabolite identification
ranked.summary: Learned and search-based models are increasingly paired with MS/MS spectral comparison to propose structures and annotate metabolites.

ranked.headline: Spatial statistics resolve molecular patterns in transcriptomic and single-molecule data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers pair scalable inference with spatial descriptors for Xenium, single-molecule, and embryogenesis atlas data.
